body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 1-unit burst within 5 units. Compare this Action against each enemy in the burst. On a success, deal 1 Psychic damage.

surges.html: Choose one affected creature; it cannot make Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Choose one affected creature; it burns 1 die on its next hostile Action.

rider.title: ASSAULT — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, choose one enemy this Action succeeds against; make it Dazed.
